1818–1870/71

Captained overland wagon companies in 1861 and 1862. Institutional sources disagree on his death year.

Parents Boaz Lambson, Polly Walworth

Spouses and partners Sarah Cordellia Harrington

Children Arba Lorenzo Lambson Jr., Drusilla Lambson, Unnamed twin daughter, Anna Hopkins Lambson, Apollos Boaz Lambson, Mary Paulina Lambson, John Allen Lambson, Almon Marion Lambson, Jonathan Thomas Lambson, Elizabeth Lillian Lambson
